claude_code.why: min: the kit's hooks need onFailure: block (2.1.295+). pin: the version the kit was last developed against (2026-11-01); not tested with this endpoint by us.

limits.text: "We have verified compatibility with Claude Code 2.0.14 and other versions": 2.0.14 is older than the kit's minimum (2.1.295), so the vendor-verified version cannot run our hooks fail-closed
the page's default and manual configurations disagree on the model mapping (all GLM-5.3-Flash vs. glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash); this profile follows the manual one
the vendor also sets API_TIMEOUT_MS=3000000 and CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=1000000; not applied by this profile
Anthropic does not support routing Claude Code to non-Claude models; treat every Claude Code upgrade as untested until the positive control passes
